brief: Vanda tracks retail order flow in NVDA after Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO. Retail met the news with $111mn of net buying in the first 30 minutes, the largest opening half-hour Vanda has recorded for NVDA and over 40x a normal open. Opens this size have historically converted into full-day net buying of 4-7x, implying $450-770mn for the full session, which would rank among the top 10 days of retail net buying in any US stock or ETF since 2014. For context, NVDA's median opening half-hour is $2.7mn and the 99th percentile is $49mn; Tuesday's $93mn open now ranks fourth-largest on record, so two of the four biggest opens have landed this week. NVDA topped the whole traded universe on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (9.7x, 14.4x and 3.7x the next most bought security) and took 61% of all US retail net buying. The buying spilled into leveraged long 2x NVDA ETFs, which saw their 5th-largest 3-day net inflow on record ($42.5mn Mon-Wed, 99.8th percentile), last matched only during the January 2025 DeepSeek drawdown. Inverse NVDA funds saw no net buying despite strong turnover, a one-way flow signal.
